note: The programme set holds what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11, docs/scope-one/WBS.md) do not already cover, plus one contract per pull request that closes programme work. Contracts here are proposed and unsigned; the signer signs after the red-team gate. Every requirement carries a source citation (file:line, contract id, or 'owner decision 31 Oct 2026'). Programme tasks that an SO-1.x contract owns are listed in `mapping` with that contract and are not re-specified.
